name: BL∞ Canonical Logic Stack — Public Projection

projection.name: Reality / embedded observer
projection.description: Public conceptual starting point: observers are embedded in a reality larger than any single representation.

projection.name: Representation / reachability
projection.description: Public distinction between what can be represented, what can be reached or constructed, and what is actually realized.

projection.name: Epistemic standing / scholarly entry
projection.description: BLEE separates equal standing to submit inspectable objects from unequal evidential weight; Academic Democracy provides the public scholarly interface.

projection.name: BL-HRD hypothesis search / reality feedback
projection.description: Reality gap -> hypothesis object -> preservation -> mapping -> depth/risk -> expected-value triage -> portfolio verification.

projection.name: Identity / provenance / living research objects
projection.description: BL-ADN, BL-LOG, BL-CHRONO, BL-PCRO, BL-OODP and BLOK preserve identity, version, dependency, critique and historical state without equating preservation with endorsement.

projection.name: Novelty / adversarial pressure
projection.description: BL-NOVO disciplines novelty claims; BL-REV and BL-AEGIS search for premise failures, countercases, contradictions and scope errors before expensive external verification.

projection.name: Reality Veto adjudication
projection.description: RVT/RVP/RVTP/RVL provide the public conceptual correction path: valid reality conflict requires model revision. Reality Veto governs every system including the unified architecture itself.

projection.name: Future regression / resource routing / agency
projection.description: BL-SFRET maps necessary future conditions and gaps; OPT-HKRP routes the minimal sufficient distributed coalition; OHAS defines authorized bounded execution, decision rights, safety and rollback.

projection.name: Knowledge-to-capability conversion
projection.description: KAT governs knowledge rights/disclosure and conversion of sufficiently supported useful knowledge into capability without permitting adverse-evidence suppression.

projection.name: Recursive frontier expansion
projection.description: New capabilities improve observation, measurement, access or construction; the expanded frontier creates new reality gaps and returns to BL∞/BL-HRD.

projection.name: Publication / critique / revision spiral
projection.description: BL-PIRAL and social-response mechanisms publish, index, collect critique, audit, patch, version and republish; reaction is feedback, not a truth vote.

projection.name: Cross-cutting constitutions
projection.description: Reality Veto provides sovereign correction; BL-ADN/LOG/CHRONO provide identity and causal memory; BL-CPR limits public disclosure to the smallest sufficient verification projection.

parallel_loops.epistemic_loop: Gap -> Hypothesis -> Critique/Test -> Evidence -> State Update -> New Gap
parallel_loops.capability_loop: Knowledge -> Resources -> Agency -> Action -> Capability -> Better Observation -> Knowledge

progress_rule: A recursive pass counts as progress only when it produces an auditable epistemic or capability delta.
guardrail: This artifact is a reduced public conceptual projection of the BL∞ unified epistemic system. It exposes roles, typed conceptual dependencies, invariants and recursive feedback only; it does not disclose the protected production router, private activation triggers, weights, ranking functions or operator playbook.
